profile.name: Triton 200低温制冷系统
profile.description: 用于超低温实验的Triton 200低温制冷系统，可读取Cernox或RuO2温度通道、设置温度设定值、更新加热器、执行受控升降温，并控制涡轮泵等低温系统部件。
profile.description_en: The Triton 200 is a cryogenic refrigeration system for ultra-low-temperature experiments. It supports reading Cernox or RuO2 temperature channels, setting temperature setpoints, updating heater behavior, running controlled temperature ramps, and controlling subsystems such as a turbo pump.
